environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (t3.medium) with direct public internet exposure via Elastic IP. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer, no reverse proxy, no CDN. Application listens directly on port 8080. Instance runs Amazon Linux 2023 with default sysctl settings. No fail2ban or similar tooling installed.
